rv.q: When she says, "I have lower expectations, so I am seldom disappointed," it's hard not to suspect she's recommending the same to us.
The resulting production is not exactly revelatory in any way.
In all its complexity, the story Marber has shaped is enthralling.

cn.t: Marber's 1945 update of Strindberg's class warfare drama draws mixed reviews: some praise its psychological depth and shifting power dynamics, while others find it pointless and lacking revelation despite a handsome production.
